product: VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1 - SDDC LCM Service API (SDDC and Fleet lifecycle management)

base_url.rule: operation paths below are appended verbatim to the injected base URL. The base URL may or may not carry a trailing slash; the joined request target must never contain an empty path segment (no '//').

auth.scheme: bearerToken (http, Bearer, JWT), declared as a root-level security requirement
auth.header: Authorization: Bearer <token>, on every request including the read-only ones

common_headers.content_type: application/json on requests that carry a body, and only on those

query.not_sent: no other query parameter exists on this operation

query.name: CREATE_COMPONENT_SUPPORT_BUNDLE_WORKFLOW
query.no_correlation_filter: the specification defines NO correlationId query parameter on getTasks. Correlation matching is a client-side scan of the returned elements. A request carrying a correlationId query parameter is a contract violation.
query.deployed_behavior: Support-bundle task summaries omit type, resourceId, and resourceType. The workflow-name filter returns those tasks with correlationId intact; resource filters return no match.

paging.indexing: one-based; pageMetadata.pageNumber is the number of the page just returned
paging.continue_while: the next page number is less than or equal to pageMetadata.totalPages AND no adoptable match has been found yet
paging.stop_early: as soon as an adoptable match is found, stop paging; do not fetch further pages
paging.invalid_metadata: a page without a usable positive integer pageMetadata.pageNumber or non-negative integer pageMetadata.totalPages cannot establish that the duplicate check is complete; fail without submitting

generateComponentSupportBundle.query: none; the request target carries no query string at all

headers.X-Correlation-Id: the caller-supplied bare UUID correlation key, sent on every submission

body_rules.lookBackWindow: optional integer, no default and not in any required list
body_rules.omission: when the caller does not supply a look-back window the property is ABSENT from the JSON body - the body serializes to an empty object. Sending null, 0, or an empty string is a contract violation.
body_rules.no_extra_properties: the body carries lookBackWindow and nothing else

generateComponentSupportBundle.success_status_rule: 202 is the ONLY documented success response for this operation. Any other 2xx, including 200, is a contract violation and must be surfaced as an error rather than parsed as a Task.
generateComponentSupportBundle.response_202: Task { id, name, status, correlationId, createTime, ... }; the deployed response omits resourceId and resourceType

task_status.note: this is the SDDC LCM 9.1 TaskStatus enum. It is NOT the SDDC Manager enum: IN_PROGRESS, SUCCESSFUL and CANCELLED (double-l) are not members and must not be accepted.

adoptable.meaning: a prior submission with this correlation key already landed and its effect stands; resubmitting would duplicate it

terminal_unsuccessful.meaning: the prior submission produced no standing effect; resubmitting is a retry, not a duplicate

task_status.unrecognized: any status string outside the enum is a protocol violation on a candidate task and must be reported, not guessed at

idempotency.problem: generateComponentSupportBundle is a mutating submission with no server-side idempotency key. A blind resubmission after a timeout or a pipeline restart starts a second bundle generation for the same component.
idempotency.key: the caller-supplied correlation key, carried outbound in the X-Correlation-Id header and read back on TaskSummary.correlationId
flow: 1. getComponents with scope=FLEET; select the component whose fqdn equals the requested FQDN exactly (byte-for-byte). No match is a caller error, not an HTTP error.
2. getTasks filtered by name=CREATE_COMPONENT_SUPPORT_BUNDLE_WORKFLOW; page through the results and collect every element whose correlationId is EXACTLY EQUAL to the UUID key.
3. If any such element has an adoptable status, adopt the first one encountered in page-then-element order: return its task id and status, and DO NOT submit.
4. Otherwise (no match at all, or every match is FAILED/CANCELED) submit generateComponentSupportBundle and return the task from the 202 body.
idempotency.matching: correlationId comparison is exact string equality on the parsed TaskSummary.correlationId field. Substring, prefix or raw-response text matching is a contract violation: task descriptions legitimately quote correlation ids in prose.
idempotency.preflight_failure: if the getComponents or getTasks pre-flight fails for any reason, the whole operation fails. Falling through to the submission after a failed duplicate check is exactly the duplication this contract exists to prevent.

errors.envelope: ErrorResponse { code (string, required), message (LocalizableMessage, required), resolution (LocalizableMessage, required), referenceId (string, required), timestamp (date-time, required), detail (string, optional) }

surface.httpStatus: the received HTTP status for a transport/protocol failure, 0 for a purely client-side failure
surface.errorCode: ErrorResponse.code when the body decodes as the envelope, otherwise null
